targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: No epistemic suppression. This is a genuine two-sided experimental result on a claim that bundles two predictions.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1048 is MECH-017's FIRST and ONLY experimental entry (prior record: 5 literature entries, 4 supports / 1 weakens; genuine_exp_count was 0). It implements the claim's own what_would_answer grid verbatim and returns a genuinely two-sided result. CONFIRMING leg MET: arm A (whole-buffer offline replay) beats the budget-matched arm B on EARLY-state probes on 5 of 5 seeds, mean relative gain 0.4542 against a pre-registered 0.05 floor (9.1x). FALSIFYING leg TRIGGERED: the claim's falsifier is 'A > B (replaying stale traces DEGRADES the model against the online comparator)', stated without a probe stratum; on LATE-state probes A > B on 5 of 5 seeds (+9.25% to +95.13%, mean +41.4%), and the effect REPLICATES on the untouched second DV (E2 self-forward late, A 11.9% worse). C2 -- 'seeds with e1_holdout_mse_late(A) <= 1.1 * e1_holdout_mse_late(B)' -- transcribes the claim's own CONFIRMING clause ('A <= B on late-state probes (no cost to recency)'), so the failing criterion is the claim's question, not a mis-specification. THE CLAIM BUNDLES TWO PREDICTIONS and this run separates them cleanly: 'replay counters forgetting' is SUPPORTED; 'at no cost to recency' is WEAKENED. Recorded for a future granularity review; the GOV-GRAN-1 recurrence trigger does NOT fire (this is the claim's only autopsy target). LIMITS, stated rather than buried: two of the claim's three named readouts were never measured (E2 world_forward, declared -- no trainer exists in ree_core; and precision_error_corr, absent from driver and manifest entirely), so the CONFIRMING conjunction was never fully evaluable; and the run calls the consolidator directly rather than inside a sleep cycle (declared, driver:52-61). Arm C (no extra training) is a readiness control under the claim's own non-degeneracy precondition (i) and is correctly NOT used as the cost comparator. LATE_TOL = 0.10 is an unanchored pre-registered constant with no measured noise floor, but it is NOT load-bearing here: C2 would need a tolerance of >= 0.4706 to flip, and the A > B sign is consistent 5/5 on both DVs.

learning_extracted: MECH-017 is two claims wearing one id. A matched-budget design cannot satisfy both conjuncts at once unless replay strictly dominates a stratum specialist on that specialist's own stratum -- and the run shows it does not. The separable successor question is whether the recency deficit is INTRINSIC to replay or an artefact of REALLOCATING a fixed budget; that needs an arm with ADDITIONAL rather than reallocated budget, and it is a NEW question, not a re-spec of C2.

When an autopsy wants to change a failing criterion's comparator, check the CLAIM's own pre-registration first. This autopsy's first draft proposed re-specifying C2 against arm C and was wrong: the claim itself names arm B on that leg, and arm C only as a readiness control. The Step 7c pass caught it, and also showed the swap would not even have rescued C2 (3/5 against a threshold of 4).
A cost claim and a foregone-benefit claim need different comparators, and the manifest supported both readings -- but only one of them is the claim's.
